name: Band Pull Apart
description: Upper-back exercise for posture: hold the band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until your shoulder blades squeeze, which also opens the chest.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart, palms down.
cues: Squeeze your shoulder blades together as the band opens.
Harder: start with your hands closer together.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Arms forward
keyframes.cue: Arms straight out in front at shoulder height, band just taut.

keyframes.name: Pull apart
keyframes.cue: Sweep your hands out to the sides and squeeze your shoulder blades.
